Space debris laser ranging operations in support of the EU Space Surveillance and Tracking (EU SST) 2
The aim of this invitation to tender is to commission a Laser Ranging Station to carry out operational measurements that should complement the services defined for EU SST, and especially the EU SST catalogue of orbital debris.
